products.name: Dance with the Devil
products.subtitle: CHECKMATE
products.tagline: A provocative game of dark cherry, smoked oud, and forbidden velvet.
products.description: An unapologetic olfactory masterpiece designed for those who command the room. Dance with the Devil opens with an intoxicating rush of black cherry drenched in vintage cognac, descending into a dark heart of smoked patchouli and velvet suede.
products.story: Born from a midnight challenge in an underground Parisian parlor, this fragrance defies traditional perfumery rules. It couples sweet sin with deep woody authority, creating an intoxicating trail that lingers like a tactical checkmate.
products.inspiration: The thrill of high-stakes tension; the shadow cast by an obsidian chess piece beneath a single spotlight.

gridPanels.title: Dark Cherry & Cognac
gridPanels.subtitle: The Seductive Opening
gridPanels.description: Hand-harvested dark cherries soaked in aged French oak cognac barrels, yielding a rich liquorice sweetness.

gridPanels.title: Smoked Oud Bark
gridPanels.subtitle: The Olfactory Spine
gridPanels.description: A rare 30-year wild Cambodian oud resin, slowly steam-distilled to extract intense woody warmth.

gridPanels.title: Tactical Temptation
gridPanels.subtitle: The Psychological State
gridPanels.description: The electrifying quiet right before making the final decisive move on the board.

gridPanels.title: Midnight Checkmate
gridPanels.subtitle: The Aesthetic Vision
gridPanels.description: Obsidian ceramic reflection under dim spotlighting, celebrating bold rebellion and quiet triumph.

products.name: Fire in the Hole
products.subtitle: CHECKMATE
products.tagline: A detonation of black pepper, smouldering incense, and molten amber.
products.description: A fragrance built on controlled combustion. Fire in the Hole opens on a blast of crushed black pepper and pink chili, settling into a smouldering heart of frankincense and charred cedar before a molten amber base takes hold.
products.story: Named for the split second before the fuse reaches its end. Housed in the obsidian Grandmaster silhouette, it turns heat into strategy—loud on arrival, calculated in the drydown.
products.inspiration: Gunpowder smoke drifting over a polished black chess piece under a single hard spotlight.

gridPanels.title: Crushed Black Pepper
gridPanels.subtitle: The Ignition
gridPanels.description: Malabar peppercorns cracked at the moment of blending, releasing a dry volatile heat that hits before anything else.

gridPanels.title: Somali Frankincense
gridPanels.subtitle: The Smouldering Heart
gridPanels.description: Hand-tapped resin tears burned low and slow, lending a sacred smoke that carries the spice without dulling it.

gridPanels.title: Controlled Detonation
gridPanels.subtitle: The Psychological State
gridPanels.description: The composure of knowing exactly when to strike—and holding the match a beat longer than anyone expects.

gridPanels.title: Obsidian Grandmaster
gridPanels.subtitle: The Aesthetic Vision
gridPanels.description: The lacquered black vessel absorbing every point of light, gold lettering the only thing permitted to shine.

products.name: Fire in the Hole II
products.subtitle: CHECKMATE 2
products.tagline: The second move—warm saffron, golden resin, and polished suede.
products.description: The counterpart composition. Where the first burns, the second glows: saffron and toasted nutmeg over a golden resin heart, finished with polished suede and a long amber trail.
products.story: A sequel written in warmer ink. Same obsidian silhouette, softer light—the follow-up move made once the board has already been claimed.
products.inspiration: The same black bottle photographed against pale studio light, casting one long deliberate shadow.

gridPanels.title: Persian Saffron
gridPanels.subtitle: The Golden Opening
gridPanels.description: Hand-picked threads yielding a leathery warmth worth more per gram than the gold on the bottle.

gridPanels.title: Honeyed Tobacco Leaf
gridPanels.subtitle: The Amber Core
gridPanels.description: Cured leaf steeped in raw honey and labdanum, giving the composition its slow golden burn.

gridPanels.title: The Second Move
gridPanels.subtitle: The Psychological State
gridPanels.description: Confidence after the fact—no need to raise your voice when the position is already won.

gridPanels.title: Light on Obsidian
gridPanels.subtitle: The Aesthetic Vision
gridPanels.description: A pale studio backdrop turning the black vessel into pure sculpted contour and shadow.
